_note: Finalized printable character cards for The Lalbagh Glass House Mystery.
victim: Basavanna, a meddlesome Bangalore socialite and gossip blogger
crime_scene: Broken black umbrella and spilled brass tumbler of filter coffee near the lake path
murder_weapon: Curved sickle used for harvesting coconuts and garden maintenance
host_rules: Primary suspects include The Overworked Flower Show Coordinator through The Tender Coconut Vendor (the secret killer).
Investigators (The Bird Watcher through The Bench-Sitting Senior Citizen) hold eyewitness clues, solid alibis, and red herrings.
If fewer than 20 people show up, assign primary suspect cards first, then investigator cards.
Clue window for claimed alibis is 3:15–3:45 PM. Only the killer may lie when asked direct questions.

characters.title: The Overworked Flower Show Coordinator
characters.secret_motive: Basavanna discovered that during the Independence Day Flower Show, you accidentally ruined the flagship floral monument and framed a junior staff member who was fired for it. They were going to expose your cover-up to the horticulture board tonight.
characters.alibi: You claim you were dismantling display frames inside the Glass House at 3:30 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: I saw the Self-Proclaimed Botanist Googling a simple hibiscus plant for identification!

characters.title: The Marathon Runner
characters.secret_motive: Basavanna deliberately tripped you during last month's Bangalore Midnight Marathon, ruining your chance at a major athletic sponsorship deal.
characters.alibi: You claim you were leading a public cool-down stretch session on the grass opposite the hill from 3:00 to 4:00 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: I saw the Filter Coffee Vendor cursing out Basavanna face-to-face near the Silk Cotton Tree earlier today!
characters.costume_note: Wears an athletic sweatband/wrap for workout support (wrist-wrap red herring).

characters.title: The Self-Proclaimed Botanist
characters.secret_motive: Basavanna discovered that your award-winning hybrid orchid entry in the Independence Day Flower Show was actually smuggled out of a private government conservatory. They were threatening to report you for plant theft.
characters.alibi: You claim you were taking notes inside the Bonsai Garden alone at 3:30 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: I overheard the Flower Show Coordinator offering a massive cash bribe to a park inspector near the administrative office earlier today!

characters.title: The Filter Coffee Vendor
characters.secret_motive: Basavanna publicly posted a viral social media review claiming your legendary filter coffee was diluted with chicory, threatening to ruin your family's 30-year business.
characters.alibi: You claim you were drinking tea with the Morning Walker Club at your West Gate stall from 3:15 to 3:45 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: The Tech Startup Founder was screaming into their phone near the lake at 3:30 PM, threatening to ruin Basavanna!
characters.deductive_purpose: Placed near lake on board call

characters.title: The Tech Startup Founder
characters.secret_motive: Basavanna stole your startup’s proprietary AI eco-tracking source code and sold it to a competing firm, destroying your company’s core valuation overnight.
characters.alibi: You claim you were taking an urgent call with your board of directors near the lake at 3:30 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: The Wealthy NRI Investor was desperately offering Basavanna a briefcase full of cash near the gazebo to buy back some incriminating land deeds!

characters.title: The Wealthy NRI Investor
characters.secret_motive: Basavanna was blackmailing your family over illegal land acquisitions made near Jayanagar back in the 1990s.
characters.alibi: You claim you were sitting in an air-conditioned car outside the West Gate around 3:20 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: The Street Photographer was bragging earlier about setting up a hidden camera near the lake path.

characters.title: The Street Photographer
characters.secret_motive: Basavanna caught you taking unauthorized drone footage over restricted park zones during the Flower Show setup and threatened to have your camera equipment confiscated.
characters.alibi: You claim you were changing camera lenses near the lake path at 3:30 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: The Coconut Vendor always wears a tight cloth wrap around their right wrist, even on extremely hot August days.
characters.costume_note: Wears a leather/cloth camera strap wrapped around their wrist (wrist-wrap red herring).

characters.title: The Tender Coconut Vendor
characters.secret_motive: You are actually the infamous 'Gandhinagar Diamond Smuggler' who fled police custody years ago. Basavanna recognized your face from a Deccan Herald retrospective on famous Bangalore criminals that ran on the 26th anniversary of Veerappan kidnapping Rajkumar, and they were going to call the cops tonight.
characters.alibi: You lie and say you were continuously at your cart chopping Elaneer (coconuts) near the North Gate from 3:15 to 3:45 PM. (You may LIE if asked direct questions!)
characters.whisper_clue: I saw the Hopcoms Juice Vendor wiping down a heavy blade near their fruit crates right around 3:30 PM! (Strategic lie shifting blame)
characters.costume_note: Wears a tight cloth wrap hiding their criminal skull tattoo.

characters.title: The Bird Watcher
characters.whisper_clue: Through my binoculars, I saw Basavanna holding up a newspaper clipping in front of a fruit vendor at 3:15 PM!
characters.goal: Mingle with everyone, trade your secret rumor, and figure out who attacked Basavanna!

characters.title: The Hopcoms Juice Vendor
characters.whisper_clue: The Mango Stall Vendor tried to borrow my heavy fruit knife earlier today because their own cutting tools went missing.
characters.goal: Mingle with everyone, trade your secret rumor, and figure out who attacked Basavanna!
